<issue>
[BUG] S3 DeleteBucketReplication deletes the entire bucket
## Service

S3

## AWS API Action

DeleteBucketReplication

## Expected behavior

Real S3 `DELETE /{bucket}?replication` removes only the replication configuration and returns `204`. A sub-resource-qualified DELETE never deletes the bucket. `HeadBucket` afterward returns `200`.

## Actual behavior

`delete-bucket-replication` returns success, but the bucket itself is destroyed. The `?replication` sub-resource is not handled and falls through to the unqualified `DeleteBucket`. A subsequent `head-bucket` returns `404`:

```
An error occurred (404) when calling the HeadBucket operation: Not Found
```

## Reproduction

```bash
aws --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 s3api create-bucket --bucket repro-bucket
aws --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 s3api delete-bucket-replication --bucket repro-bucket
aws --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 s3api head-bucket --bucket repro-bucket
# => An error occurred (404) when calling the HeadBucket operation: Not Found
```

## Environment

- Floci version / image tag: 1.5.32
- Java SDK version (if applicable): n/a — AWS CLI 2.35.7
- How you're running Floci: Docker


</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed find the S3 controller (Java) handling DELETE on bucket with sub-resources like ?policy, ?lifecycle, ?replication, and PUT/GET ?replication. Report file path, line numbers and the code of the DELETE bucket handler(s) and any replication handling in the service.

content.content: {"summary":"The S3 DELETE bucket handler is in S3Controller.deleteBucket, which dispatches on sub-resource query params (tagging, website, policy, cors, lifecycle, encryption, publicAccessBlock, ownershipControls) before falling through to plain bucket deletion. The service has no replication support: no ?replication handling exists in the S3 controller, S3Service, or model. The only 'replication' hits in src/main are ElastiCache replication groups.","findings":["src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/services/s3/S3Controller.java:280-319 — @DELETE @Path(\"/{bucket}\") deleteBucket(): validateRawUri(); then if hasQueryParam for \"tagging\" (→ s3Service.deleteBucketTagging), \"website\" (→ deleteBucketWebsite), \"policy\" (line 293 → deleteBucketPolicy), \"cors\" (line 297 → deleteBucketCors), \"lifecycle\" (line 301 → deleteBucketLifecycle), \"encryption\" (line 305 → deleteBucketEncryption), \"publicAccessBlock\" (→ deletePublicAccessBlock), \"ownershipControls\" (line 313 → deleteBucketOwnershipControls); otherwise line 317 s3Service.deleteBucket(bucket); returns Response.noContent(); AwsException → xmlErrorResponse.","No ?replication branch in the DELETE handler; no DELETE ?replication is handled.","src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/services/s3/S3Controller.java:~212-226 — PUT bucket dispatch handles ?policy, ?cors, ?lifecycle, ?acl, ?logging, ?website; no ?replication branch.","src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/services/s3/S3Controller.java:~381-395 — GET bucket dispatch handles ?policy, ?cors, ?lifecycle, etc.; no ?replication branch.","src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/services/s3/S3Service.java:206 — deleteBucket(): ensureBucketExists, then rejects non-empty buckets with BucketNotEmpty 409 (listObjects limit 1).","src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/services/s3/S3Service.java:1578-1583 — deleteBucketPolicy(): sets policy to null and stores bucket; throws NoSuchBucket 404 if missing.","src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/services/s3/S3Service.java:1727-1733 — deleteBucketLifecycle(): clears lifecycleConfiguration and transitionDefaultMinimumObjectSize; NoSuchBucket 404 if missing.","Replication-related matches under src/main are only in services/elasticache/ElastiCacheQueryHandler.java (CreateReplicationGroup etc.), unrelated to S3. Lifecycle-related model field is in services/s3/model/Bucket.java."],"confidence":0.85}

content.text: Minimal: no replication storage exists; just return 204 after checking the bucket exists. I'll use an existing method to check existence.

input.instruction: In /testbed S3Service.java, is there a public method to check bucket existence (e.g. headBucket/ensureBucketExists public)? Report its signature.

content.content: {"summary":"S3Service has a public headBucket method that serves as the bucket-existence check. There is no public boolean existence check.","findings":["src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/services/s3/S3Service.java:1089: `public void headBucket(String bucketName)` — calls ensureBucketExists(bucketName) and returns nothing.","S3Service.java:2404: `private void ensureBucketExists(String bucketName)` — not public, so it cannot be called from outside the class.","S3Service.java:1093: `public String getBucketRegion(String bucketName)` also calls ensureBucketExists before returning the region.","No public boolean bucket-existence method was found (grep for exist/ensure/check returned only the private readableObjectExists at line 540 and ensureBucketExists)."],"confidence":0.9}
